Ana: Quick sync 0 customers flagged for upcoming renewals have integration test failures. Proposal: run a 60m Enablement Clinic focused on integration testing + a lightweight renewal readiness checklist. Who can help run it next week?
Marcus: I can lead the integration test walkthrough. Prefer Mon July 18 10:00 AM PT.
Gina: I'll take the SDK integration blockers and sample code review. Also request a small preread with common error codes.
Tom (CS): We should gate lab seats to accounts with open integration tickets. Cap to 15 live seats, open overflow to watch-only stream. I'll build a short preregistration form.
enablement-bot: Reminder: attach any workshop assets to /Enablement/Clinics/Integration-Clinic/ and tag #enablement before event.
Ana: Agenda draft:
- 5m intros + goals
- 10m common failure patterns & quick triage checklist (Marcus)
- 20m SDK integration walkthrough + live debugging (Gina)
- 20m breakout lab for hands-on fixes (15 seats) + watch stream
- 5m renewal-readiness checklist + next steps (Tom)
Marcus: Suggest we include a tiny runbook: if latency spike during load test, toggle fallback model and open ticket.
Gina: I'll produce the preread zip with a minimal repro app and a list of 6 error codes to check.
Tom (CS): Form fields: account name, ticket id(s), technical contact, preferred lab seat (y/n). I'll post link in 45m. Also will sync with AEs to invite only accounts with active tickets.
Ana: Can someone write a 1-line invite blurb for AEs? Need <150 chars.
Marcus: Draft: "Integration Clinic: targeted 60m session to clear SDK & integration blockers ahead of renewal."
Gina: Tiny tweak: add "hands-on" -> "Integration Clinic: 60m hands-on session to clear SDK & integration blockers before renewal."
Ana: Good. Action items:
- Tom: form + calendar invite + Zoom (today EOD)
- Gina: preread + repro app + error code doc (by Thu)
- Marcus: runbook + triage checklist (by Thu)
- Ana: confirm attendee gating with AEs and publish invite (tomorrow)
Tom (CS): Form live: https://forms.gle/clinic-integ-abc 0 please keep internal. Will post attendee list and start a waitlist once we hit 15.
Gina: Volunteers to help in breakout rooms? react with :hand: and I'll split rooms by stack language (python/js/go).
Marcus: :hand:
Ana: :hand:
Tom (CS): :hand:
